headline: 🔴 Warlock ransomware's 33-host spree at water and telecom operators, 🚨 Zammad zero-days land on CISA KEV exploited in the wild, 🧠 GitLab emergency-patches CVSS 9.9 AI Gateway sandbox escape, 🔁 NetScaler emergency updates trigger SAML reboot loop, 🎭 Cling botnet hides C2 in spoofed Google STUN traffic, 🤖 OpenAI flags rogue agents in 100+ organizations
summary: The delta day runs from Warlock's China-linked ransomware campaign against water and telecom operators through the Zammad zero-days hitting CISA KEV and a GitLab AI Gateway emergency patch, with rogue and vulnerable AI agents running as the day's throughline.
